verses.text: At that time, you will say to your fellow-Israeli men, “You are God’s people,” and you will say to your fellow-Israeli women, “You are ones whom God loves.”
Yahweh also said to me, “I want you to accuse the Israeli people.
If they do not do that,
I will not pity the people,
Their parents are like prostitutes [MET]: they have been unfaithful to me,
So it will be as though [MET] I am blocking their road with thornbushes,
They will run to their idols/gods that they think love them,
But they do not realize that I, Yahweh, am the one who gave them grain and wine and olive oil;
Therefore I will return and take my grain and grapes from them when they are ripe.
I will show those false gods/idols that what my people are doing is disgusting [MET],
I will cause their religious celebrations to cease,
I will destroy all their grapevines and fig trees,
I will punish my people for all the times that they burned incense to honor the idols of Baal.
But listen! Some day I will persuade my people to worship me again;
I will give their vineyards back to them,
At that time,
I will not allow them to speak [MTY] the names of Baal;
At that time it will be as though I will make an agreement
I will cause them to be as though they are [MET] my bride forever.
I will not abandon them,
At that time, when they request me to do things for them,
and grain will grow, and the vineyards and the olive trees will grow in Jezreel Valley.
At that time, I will take care of the Israeli people
